target.statement: Clustering accuracy of i-IF-Lap on the SRBCT gene microarray dataset (K=4, n=63, p=2308), reported as 0.984 in Table 1.

compute.basis: The paper reports all experiments on a 2-core CPU with 8 GB RAM; the target is a single small dataset (63x2308) with an iterative PCA/Laplacian-eigenmap + k-means pipeline, so a few minutes of compute plus install/download time is realistic.

blockers: Code repository may not include exact preprocessing scripts or the SRBCT data file; data must be downloaded from Mendeley and preprocessed per Appendix D.2.
Exact reproduction of 0.984 may require matching random seeds and the full iterative stopping rule; the paper does not specify all seeds.
title: i-IF-Learn: Iterative Feature Selection and Unsupervised Learning for High-Dimensional Complex Data
